name: Moore Public Schools
seoTitle: Moore Public Schools Calendar | Moore, Oklahoma
seoDescription: Moore Public Schools calendar dates for Moore, Oklahoma, including breaks, conference days, professional days, weather notes, official PDFs, and ICS files.
districtFact: Moore Public Schools publishes a BOE-approved annual calendar and a live district calendar. Use the annual PDF for districtwide dates and the live calendar for event times and later updates.

about.title: Use the Annual PDF and Live Calendar Together
about.content: The BOE-approved annual PDF is the source for districtwide dates. The live MPS calendar provides event times and later updates, while individual schools publish campus-specific activities and appointment details.

about.title: Weather Planning Uses Banked Minutes
about.content: MPS says Oklahoma students must complete 1,086 instructional hours and that the district considers its banked minutes before deciding whether lost time must be made up. ParentSquare is the primary family notification source, and the district aims to announce a cancellation by 6 a.m.

calendarNotes: Use the BOE-approved annual PDF for districtwide dates and the live MPS calendar for event times and later updates. Check individual school announcements for campus activities and appointment details. When weather interrupts instruction, MPS uses ParentSquare as its primary family notification source and considers banked minutes before deciding whether missed time must be made up.

districtFaqs.q: How does Moore Public Schools announce weather closures?
districtFaqs.a: MPS identifies ParentSquare as its primary notification source and also uses its website and local media. The district says officials begin checking routes early and aim to notify families by 6 a.m. when school is canceled.
